newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SCOTLAND'S MCCALL TO MISS REST OF SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCOTLAND'S MCCALL TO MISS REST OF SEASON.

text.p: Glasgow Rangers' Scotland international Stuart McCall will miss the rest of the season with a knee injury, Rangers manager Walter Smith said on Friday.
The 32-year-old midfielder picked up the injury in a Champions' League match against Ajax earlier this season. He had surgery but his attempt to return to full fitness has failed.
McCall is likely to miss at least four World Cup qualifying matches for Scotland.
